---
title: "Sprott L System"
---

## Simulation

The governing equations of this chaotic system are

$$
\begin{eqnarray}
\dot{x} &=& y+z\\
\dot{y} &=& ax^2-y\\
\dot{z} &=& 1-x
\end{eqnarray}
$$

with $a=0.24$ and initial condition $(-6,4,-8)$.
